origin.source: Cloudflare Agents integration; a workspace package with a real wrangler project, booted locally with `wrangler dev` and tested in workerd via @cloudflare/vitest-plugin

comparison.purpose: Log-as-truth persistence on Cloudflare: the Durable Object stores an append-only AgentLogEntry journal in its own SQLite storage and resumes by replay through runDurableAgent, keeping no snapshot at all; keyless scripted executors by default, live AI SDK models when OPENAI_API_KEY is bound.
